name: perf-spawn
js: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(1500);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<3500)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] spawn '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)+' ms lake '+__CITY_APP.scene.getObjectByName('LakeOntario').visible)})()
